stem: If \(5 - 2x \ge -9\), what is the greatest possible value of \(x\)?
solution: Divide by \(-2\) and reverse the sign: \(x \le 7\).
The inequality includes equality, so the greatest possible value of \(x\) is 7.
verify:
x = symbols('x')
s = solve_univariate_inequality(5 - 2*x >= -9, x, relational=False)
assert s == Interval(-oo, 7)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [s.sup]
